ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-intensity (white/off-white) pixels occupy approximately 75% of the visible surface area, with low-intensity (black) pixels concentrated in the central junction and trailing margins.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Two primary high-intensity contiguous blobs covering the lateral expanses of the lobes. A central low-intensity 'V' shaped region connects the lobes to the peduncle. Discrete low-intensity spots and irregular banding mapped along the entire trailing edge perimeter.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with a calculated angle of approximately 45 degrees relative to the lobe midlines.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations present across the entire trailing edge. Notable irregular macro-notches observed on the distal 1/4 of the left lobe and the tip of the right lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex upper boundary sweep that tapers to sharp, slightly upturned distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Small, approximately circular high-contrast dark pixel clusters localized primarily within the white regions of the right lobe and along the black margins of both tips.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple high-intensity (white) linear streaks across the left lobe, primarily oriented at a 30-45 degree angle relative to the horizontal axis, consistent with rake mark morphology.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Visible linear rake marks on the ventral left lobe; irregular jagged indentation on the distal edge of the left lobe suggesting past trauma or tissue excision.
other_distinctive_markers: Asymmetrical pigmentation density; the right lobe contains a higher frequency of internal dark spots compared to the relatively clean high-intensity surface of the left lobe.
